detail.longDescription: Hello hive mind and happy Samhain! I've been updating my website for next year's travel season, and was wondering if there are people here with screen readers or other accessibility issues that could help me by having a look to see if the site is actually accessible or if there are things to improve. One of the main concerns is the (surprisingly effective) spam filter, in which I write the whole "mailto:abc@xyz.com" in a mix of HTML decimal and hex. Does this work for screen readers or do you hear "and-hash-one-zero-nine-semicolon-and-hash-ex-zero-zero-six-one-semicolon" etc. for an excruciatingly long time? The website is at https:// orsom.eu (only the English pages are up to date at the moment) Also, not related to the above, but after coming up with a myriad of trip names and descriptions, I've gotten writer's block now that only the name for a small gravel bike tour remains. Third one on this page: https://www. orsom.eu/en/tours.html ("Piedmont Gravel") If there's anyone who can come up with a good name for it, or have a suggestion of direction that helps me get there, I'm happy to offer you a free bike tour if you ever come to Turin :) Note that I haven't proofread properly yet, so there might be a typo or two lurking about. And if you've read all the way to here, well, boosts are welcome 😘 # hiveMind # accessibility # screenReader # askFedi # fediHelp # programming # html # css # website # webdesign # smallWeb # indieWeb # noAI # writersBlock # writersCoffeeClub
